title: A member of Congress saw a UFO come out of a lake while fishing with his son

tellings.quote: I go to Congress and and members of Congress will pull me aside and said look I had my own UFO sighting with my son literally fishing in in in a lake and the thing came out of the water

plain: Lou Elizondo, a former Pentagon official who worked on UFO questions, tells podcast host Jesse Michels that when he goes to Congress, members sometimes pull him aside to share their own sightings. One told him he was fishing on a lake with his son when an object came up out of the water. If true, it would mean even lawmakers have seen these things firsthand.
